info.name: Weapons
info.description: Weapons from Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

element.name: Wooden Stake
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: While any modest length of sharpened wood can be used as an improvised weapon, wooden stakes that have been carved, treated, and fire-hardened are specifically useful against Kindred. Dedicated wooden stakes use the weapon profile below.

Driving the Stake. If you are within 5 feet of a Kindred with the Restrained or Unconscious condition, you can take an action to make a DC 15 Intelligence (Medicine) check. On a successful check, the wooden stake is driven into the heart of the Kindred.

div.p: Nick. When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

element.name: Arrow, Silver
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: Ammunition is required by a weapon that has the Ammunition property. A weapon's description specifies the type of ammunition used by the weapon. The Ammunition table lists the different types and the amount you get when you buy them. The table also lists the item that is typically used to store each type; storage must be bought separately.

element.name: Upkeep (Silver)
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: When you make an attack roll with a silver weapon or piece of ammunition, it takes a cumulative -1 penalty to attack rolls. The weapon or piece of ammunition is destroyed if the penalty reaches -5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the object or by succeeding on a DC 10 Dexterity check using Smith's Tools as part of a Short Rest or Long Rest.

element.name: Wooden Melee Weapons
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: When you make an attack roll with this Melee weapon and roll a 1 on the d20, the weapon splinters and is destroyed.

element.name: Wooden Ammunition
element.source: Vampire the Masquerade: Bound by Blood

description.p: Wooden ammunition is destroyed after hitting or missing a target.
